First-click is a $0 dare: POST the line below to a public HTTPS echo (https://httpbingo.org/post, json mode). No local server, no NanoGPT spend, no upload. The echo hands back {data: <body>} — if you see the joke, the wire works.

NanoGPT chat contract instead: set mode to chat, URL to http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/chat/completions, and start the 20-line mock in the Custom endpoint guide. Chrome may ask once for local-network access.
The graph is the product. This line is just the receipt — echo me so I know the POST wasn't a rumor.
